segments.caption: An aerial news report shows the aftermath of a serious accident in Douglasville, Georgia, where a red car is severely damaged and wedged between a stopped train and a highway. Emergency responders, including police and tow trucks, are on the scene, and a news helicopter is visible overhead, documenting the incident.

An aerial view captures a train collision with a red car on the tracks in Douglasville, Georgia, as emergency vehicles and responders arrive. The scene is then contextualized with a map graphic pinpointing the location at the intersection of East Broad Street and Mozley Street in Douglasville, with a news reporter providing on-site coverage.

A CBS Atlanta news reporter, Steve Kiggins, provides a live on-site report at night about a train collision with a car. The broadcast graphics identify the incident location as the intersection of E Broad St and Mozley St in Douglasville, with the headline “TRAIN HITS CAR” displayed prominently.

A CBS Atlanta news reporter, Steve Kiggins, delivers a live on-site report at night from Douglasville, Douglas County. He stands on a dark, empty road, gesturing toward the scene as he provides new details on a developing story.

A live news report from Douglasville, Georgia, at night, shows a reporter gesturing toward a scene where a train has collided with a red car on the tracks, with emergency personnel and a tow truck present.

An aerial view captures a serious train collision with a red car at a railroad crossing, with emergency personnel and a police cruiser on scene. The segment then shifts to ground-level shots showing responders assessing the damage and interviewing a witness who gestures toward the accident site, confirming the incident occurred at a busy intersection in Atlanta.

A news report from Atlanta covers a train crossing incident, showing railroad workers inspecting a derailed freight car on the tracks while a local resident, Robert Woods, gestures toward the scene and speaks to the camera, describing the event that occurred near his home.

A man points towards the scene of a train collision with a red car on the tracks, while aerial footage shows the aftermath: the damaged vehicle wedged between the train and the rails, with personnel on the locomotive attending to the incident.

A red car is shown catastrophically struck by a train at a railroad crossing, with the front end crushed and the vehicle wedged on the tracks. The scene is captured from an elevated perspective, showing the aftermath of the collision as the train, with people visible on its platform, has come to a stop. The video then cuts to a different angle, showing traffic flowing normally across the crossing, highlighting the stark contrast between the ongoing road activity and the severe accident that just occurred
A news reporter stands at a railroad crossing in Atlanta, speaking to the camera as trains pass overhead and cars drive by on the adjacent road.

A news reporter stands at a railroad crossing in Atlanta, where traffic signals and train tracks intersect, as officials in safety vests inspect the scene. The footage then cuts to a nighttime aerial shot, capturing the bright lights of a cityscape, suggesting a broader context or a transition to a related story.

A news report from Atlanta shows a dramatic nighttime aerial shot of bright lights over a city, transitioning to a daytime scene at a railroad crossing where a yellow school bus is stopped on the tracks, with traffic waiting. A close-up reveals a damaged section of the road near the tracks, suggesting a recent incident or accident at the crossing.

A news report documents a serious train collision with a red car on railroad tracks at an intersection in Atlanta. The footage shows the damaged scene, including the crushed vehicle on the tracks and a train stopped nearby, while a reporter on location describes the incident.

An aerial view captures the aftermath of a collision where a red car is crushed and wedged between a stopped train and railroad tracks. Emergency responders and bystanders are present, with a tow truck arriving to remove the wreckage. The scene is shown from multiple angles, including ground-level shots of witnesses observing the incident, confirming the severity of the crash and the ongoing response.

A news report captures the aftermath of a car accident at a railroad crossing, where a red sedan is severely damaged and wedged between the tracks. Emergency personnel and a tow truck are on scene, while a reporter provides live updates and interviews a witness who appears shaken.

A CBS Atlanta news reporter, Steve Kiggins, delivers a live on-air report from an outdoor location at night. He stands on a street, holding a microphone with the station's logo, speaking to the camera as the lower third graphic displays his name, email, and the location as Atlanta with a temperature of 48 degrees. The scene remains consistent across the frames, indicating a continuous live broadcast.
